author: /root/structural
statement: For every simple SRG(99,14,1,2) adjacency matrix A and its complete99x231 binary triangle incidence matrix N, let H=A+7I, G=H mod3, V=ker G and j be the all-one vector. The divided form beta(x,y)=xhat^T H yhat/3 mod3 is well-defined on V, has rank43 and radical span(j); ker(N^T mod3) contains j and is beta-totally-isotropic. Consequently dim ker(N^T mod3)<=22 and77<=rank_F3 N<=98. This conditional necessary condition forces neither a nonconstant left-kernel vector nor target existence/nonexistence.

scope.description: Complete unrestricted target incidence only, exact integer spectrum and odd-prime local congruence; no fixed-support occurrence, small-circuit existence, binary rank transfer or target conclusion.

assumptions: A is binary symmetric zero-diagonal with all row sums14 and A^2=12I-A+2J exactly over the integers.
N includes each actual triangle exactly once, with231 columns and seven entries per row; NN^T=A+7I.

proposed_dependencies.reason: Existing exact spectral/modular target context; the new paper independently derives its needed G/E layer.

shared_origin: Root posed the incidence G/E investigation and reviewed an outline; Structural authors this candidate; outline agreement is not independent verification.
